name: Subscription and bill review service
summary: Review household subscriptions, catch auto-renewal traps, and prepare refund-demand letters backed by state auto-renewal law.

endpoints.description: Subscription review — cancel vs. keep analysis with cost savings
Subscription-trap rights check — state auto-renewal law duties, violations, and remedy math (deterministic, no LLM)
Citation-locked subscription demand letter — refund / unconditional-gift / cancellation-obstruction ($2)

THE paid action: prints and mails a real physical letter via Lob once payment settles. Price varies by service — standard $3.00, certified $12.00, certified_return_receipt $14.00, international $5.00 — the amount shown here is the representative/minimum price; the actual x402 charge always matches the caller's quote_id-verified order from POST /api/quote (free, no x402 gate). Requires a client_request_id (8-128 chars) for idempotency.

payment.pricing_note: Prices shown are the live public catalog — the same wholesale sheet agents pay per call. No subscription.
payment.human_onramp: Self-serve starter key (no crypto wallet needed): https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/start/?bp=subscription-bill-review — scoped key with a $0.25 trial balance; top up by card (Stripe) or USDC. API: POST https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/api/wholesale/register {contact, scope: "dealpulse,mailpulse"}. Email fallback: info@theaslangroupllc.com with subject "Starter key: subscription-bill-review".

setup_steps: Do your own household first and write down the annual savings number. That number is your ad.
Charge flat: one household review, one price. Resist percentage-of-savings pricing even though customers suggest it; it changes your legal posture and your incentives.
Offer three friends-and-family reviews for testimonials.
Post the plain math (average subscriptions per household, average forgotten spend) one place where your local community talks money.
licensing_notes: No license applies to reviewing bills and preparing letters the customer sends. Flat fee, not a percentage of savings. Don’t log into anyone’s accounts; they share statements, you review.

compliance.earnings: Educational content. No earnings claims or income projections; results depend on operator effort, market, and pricing.
compliance.posture: Flat-fee self-help document preparation where documents are involved: the customer signs and files; the operator never represents clients or works on contingency.
